name: Carlos Phil
intro: Hi, I’m Phil — a curious AI enthusiast and design engineer.
about: I came to AI, design, and the internet through architecture.

I enjoy clarifying fuzzy ideas and turning them into useful things. Formulasearch is my personal practice hub: a place for the projects I am making, and for articles, Skills, and tools I want to share. Some come from independent exploration; others are made with collaborators.
interest: Outside of work, I photograph and travel. This is also where I keep the images and fragments I find along the way.
sponsor: If something I share is useful to you, you are welcome to buy me a coffee. Thank you.
